clauses.title: Registry evidence
clauses.text: Approved supplier status must be supported by the current supplier registry record at the evaluation time.

clauses.title: Exact identity matching
clauses.text: Supplier approval must be checked using the confirmed supplier identifier. Policy-text similarity must not be used to infer or repair supplier identity.

clauses.title: Inactive supplier
clauses.text: A supplier whose registry status is inactive is not eligible for an approved-supplier recommendation.

clauses.title: Expired or missing approval
clauses.text: An expired approval period or missing registry record requires procurement review and must not be treated as approved.

clauses.title: Electronics evidence requirement
clauses.text: Electronics purchases require current RoHS evidence for each compared part before a supplier can be marked compliant.

clauses.title: Accepted evidence
clauses.text: Accepted evidence is a signed supplier declaration or a recognized certificate that states the applicable RoHS scope and issue date.

clauses.title: Evidence identity
clauses.text: The supplier identifier and part identifier on RoHS evidence must match the confirmed supplier and requested part records.

clauses.title: Missing or expired evidence
clauses.text: Missing, expired, or mismatched RoHS evidence requires review. Retrieval similarity alone cannot establish RoHS compliance.

clauses.title: Approval threshold
clauses.text: A proposed award with total landed cost of SGD 10,000 or more requires manager approval before publication.

clauses.title: Threshold basis
clauses.text: The approval threshold is evaluated against total landed cost after required charges and approved currency conversion have been applied.

clauses.title: Approval evidence
clauses.text: The approving manager, approval timestamp, approved amount, and related task revision must be recorded as evidence.

clauses.title: Foreign currency evaluation
clauses.text: A foreign-currency award must use the approved exchange-rate snapshot effective at the evaluation timestamp when testing the SGD approval threshold.
